method: Predictions derived from product source before inspecting any consolidated Python or new Verus predictions. New hypotheses deliberately separated.

inputs: Activate before hook, Defer=0
Activate before hook, Defer=1 then after hook
cases.prediction: Immediate copy exists before core Activate; deferred copy appears only after core Activate. A later failure before the after hook prevents deferred copy.

inputs: successful DoCopy inside TSTART then TROLLBACK
missing source DoCopy inside TSTART then TROLLBACK
cases.prediction: Successful filesystem copy survives database rollback; missing source returns error and leaves no copied target.
cases.environment: IRIS %File writes are outside database transaction; must validate natively

inputs: Clean with KeepOnUninstall=1
Clean with KeepOnUninstall=0 on unprotected directory
cases.prediction: Keep flag preserves target and marks handled; absent flag removes target. Protected directory always retained.

inputs: CreateLockFile=1, valid graph, later compile failure
CreateLockFile=0 with same compile failure
cases.prediction: First can leave module-lock.json although parent DB record rolls back; second never creates lockfile. Lockfile is generated after dependencies and before parent ExecutePhases.

inputs: valid dependency load, writable root
valid dependency load, lockfile target nonwritable
cases.prediction: Lockfile failure is printed and swallowed by LoadDependencies; it alone does not fail parent load. Writable root creates file.

inputs: MergeCPF child exits 0, later database rollback
MergeCPF child exits nonzero
cases.prediction: Success does not imply rollback reverses external configuration; nonzero child exit is converted to failure with output detail. No product compensation path exists in CPF.OnPhase Clean.
cases.environment: child iris merge behavior not validated here; do not mutate running system config

inputs: Init temp/twin; finalize and persist without delete
Init temp/twin; delete persistent twin; finalize and persist stale twin
cases.prediction: Both histories share the same temp object before persistence. No explicit deletion generation or tombstone prevents stale persistence. The final existence/status after delete is an OPEN environment/concurrency question to test, not an asserted defect. Reader before deletion sees unfinished row.

inputs: process ends after Init with IRISTEMP state
instance restarts after Init with IRISTEMP state
cases.prediction: Instance restart clears IRISTEMP unlike mere process end; persistent unfinished twin can remain. Whether %OnClose finalizes on process death is distinct and must be observed for the termination mechanism.

inputs: sync writes/hashes committed then tests fail
sync compilation fails before CommitChanges
cases.prediction: Test failure preserves synced hashes and does not mark those paths for retry. Compilation failure leaves uncommitted changes eligible for retry.

inputs: Show with existing Name
Show with same existing ExternalName and different case
Show with missing name
cases.prediction: Show tries Name then ExternalName; only missing record throws installed-module error. Output target is the selected stored module, not arbitrary repository metadata. Case handling relies on datatype collation.
